郄曇 (Xi Tan) is a full name referring to a distinct person. The annotation says '郄曇以疾還彭城' - Xi Tan returned to Pengcheng due to illness. He is distinct from 萬 (Xie Wan) and 太宗 (the emperor).
簡文 is the ruler title for Emperor Jianwen (司馬昱). He asks (問) 郄超 a question about 謝萬's defeat. He is distinct from 郄超 and from 伊 (who is 郄超 referring to 謝萬).

萬 in the Liu annotation refers to 謝萬 (Xie Wan). The annotation says '萬以為賊盛致退便向還' - Wan thought the enemy was strong and retreated. He is the object of 太宗's reproach and demotion.
